candidates.change_summary: Change the access check to allow anyone to call withdrawAll (removed owner check), allowing different caller to trigger withdrawals which can affect resulting state observed via withdrawal behavior.
Invert the access check so only non-owner can call withdrawAll, altering which caller can successfully withdraw and thus the observable state after the call.
Change transfer target to send funds to the transaction sender instead of the provided recipient, altering who receives the balance and thus observable behavior.
Prevent any transfer by commenting out the transfer line, so withdrawAll no longer changes contract balance and observable state differs.
Make the function send only half the contract balance to the recipient, changing the post-call contract balance and thus observable behavior.
Insert an additional transfer to owner after sending to recipient, causing a different final contract balance and observable behavior.
Replace transfer with low-level call forwarding all gas and not reverting on failure, changing observable reversion behavior and final balances.
